title: Basic PAYE Tools user guide
text:
This guide gives you step by step help to run your payroll using  Basic PAYE Tools as an employer with fewer than 10 employees.  

 All Basic PAYE Tools user guides are updated only when there are major changes. They may not be updated yearly.

 You must register with HMRC for PAYE Online as an employer before you use Basic PAYE Tools to run your payroll calculations and submissions.
changeNote: How to use Basic PAYE Tools section Calculate statutory payment has been updated to include Statutory Parental Bereavement Pay — Northern Ireland (SPBP-NIRE).
